title: Restart leaves nothing of the previous run
intent: Every restart starts a clean run with no stale timers, listeners, enemies, bullets or purchases

attempts.approach: HUD text cache as a scene field initialised only at declaration
attempts.failureReason: the scene object survives scene.restart, so the cache carried the previous run text into the next one

evidence.description: listener, timer, tween, collider, body and display-object counts after three restarts matched a fresh load, including a restart mid-wave with bullets in flight and pending hit-flash timers
after restart one listener each for E, Q, 1, 2, 3 and none for R; pistol only, lockers and gate reset
Current Git HEAD commit at time of record

constraints.statement: create() reassigns every per-run field, because Phaser reuses the scene object across scene.restart
WaveDirector keeps no timers or scene listeners and is driven by update(now), so shutdown leaves nothing of it; per-enemy listeners are removed when the enemy is destroyed
Key listeners go on the scene keyboard plugin, which removes them all on shutdown; nothing listens on game-level emitters
